name: Benchmark Dataset for Non-Lambertian and Uncalibrated Photometric Stereo
description: A dataset and evaluation protocol for measuring photometric stereo algorithms' ability to recover surface normals under non-Lambertian reflectance and uncalibrated lighting conditions.
reputation: Well-regarded and frequently cited in the photometric-stereo research community for evaluating non-Lambertian and uncalibrated algorithms.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on controlled capture of objects under varying illumination; dataset size and scene diversity are limited and results may not fully generalize to in-the-wild conditions. Evaluation is sensitive to ground-truth normal quality and calibration.
